recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-22695 unless a future work group decision changes the narrative translation model.
issue_request: FHIR-22695 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request asking to remove the Language page sentence that said there was no way to provide multiple translations for resource narrative, because Narrative now describes how to handle that scenario.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite merge commit fd43c185d1e0e083caf95f6b6ad99cb86c49a95a as fixed. The implementation commit f12cbe36661085046c474860129f42357b7e4a16 removed the six-line obsolete paragraph from source/languages.html, and source history shows that exact text has not been reintroduced.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists languages.html as the Multi-Language Support page, and source/documentation.html links to it, so source/languages.html is in current build scope. Current source/languages.html and source/narrative.html both describe language-tagged XHTML div content for resources containing the same information in multiple languages. FHIR-37616 later addressed broken anchors on the same page and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative current source already satisfies FHIR-22695 and no additional source edit is needed.

related_jiras.note: A later same-page anchor/link cleanup encountered during topic search; it already has Issue-Reconcile-Key FHIR-37616 on the combined branch and does not change the completed FHIR-22695 sentence removal.
